title: UPDATE: Aries Raises $7M in Seed Round Led by Thomas Peterffy
summary:
Kleiner Perkins, John Paulson and 638 of the company's own users participated in a $7 million seed funding round for Aries led by Thomas Peterffy. The capital will support the development of an AI-integrated stock trading platform, and the company is currently offering new account holders one free share of stock with a value of up to $500.

The funding comes after the launch of Aries Infinite, a modular trading workspace where traders use widgets or natural language prompts to customize their screens. The system integrates TradingView charts and Bloomberg TV on mobile and utilizes a finance.dev API and a proprietary Model Context Protocol to provide dedicated trading rails for AI agents.
